name: inputs/range-slider
title: Range slider
description: One or two thumbs with a live value readout.

files.content:
export { RangeSlider } from './RangeSlider';
export type { RangeSliderProps, SliderValue } from './RangeSlider';

keyboard.action: Change by a tenth of the range.
Go to the lowest or highest value allowed.

notes: Each thumb is a `slider` with `aria-valuemin`, `aria-valuemax`, `aria-valuenow` and `aria-valuetext`, following the WAI-ARIA slider and multi-thumb slider patterns.
In a range, each thumb’s limits are the other thumb’s value, so assistive technology knows how far it can go.
Thumbs are named by the slider’s label plus “Minimum” or “Maximum” (configurable with `thumbLabels`).
The visible thumb is 22 px; an invisible ring extends its target to 44 px.
The value shown above the thumb is decorative; the same text reaches screen readers through `aria-valuetext`.
accessibility.reducedMotion: The thumb and the value bubble respond without growing or sliding.
